reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "For IPsec, support for a single key has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: IPsec configurations using single key mode will automatically transition to per-tunnel keys; tunnel behavior may change depending on the per-tunnel key configuration.

proposed.statement: IPsec single key support (indicated by the + sign in secrets) has been removed; per-tunnel keys are now always used regardless of the + sign's presence.
